description: Permission matrix for KALLAX v1 — 6 roles × 10 actions. Each cell encodes the authoritative grant decision (ALLOW/DENY) as enforced by scripts/permission/authz/check.sh. The integration tests in tests/integration/rbac-integration-test.sh consume this matrix as the oracle and assert reality matches the spec.

actions.description: Claim a ticket for execution in an isolated worktree
Dispatch a ticket to a Performer
Create an isolated worktree for a ticket
Commit changes inside the worker's worktree
Read ticket content (acceptance criteria, scope, status)
Write directly to the miao (production) branch — conductor-only P0 violation
Merge a PR into miao — master-only
Merge a PR into testing — conductor+
Terminate a KALLAX instance — emergency-responder only, NOT master

notes.fail_closed_per_role: Each role has an explicit allowlist in scripts/permission/authz/check.sh::check_permission. Anything outside the allowlist = DENY (closed deny-set PER ROLE). Master is the only role with broad grants (everything EXCEPT instance.terminate).
notes.super_admin_v2_deferred: super-admin is NOT in the v1 allowlist — v2 scope per confluence/decisions/PERMISSION-MODEL-EXPERT-REVIEW-2026-06-07.md. All super-admin cells = DENY until v2 lands.
notes.conductor_miao_write_block: AC-3 from EPIC-022-B: conductor attempting miao.write MUST exit 1 with audit log entry. Verified by Test [E2E-CONDUCTOR-MIAO].
notes.performer_merge_block: AC-4 from EPIC-022-B: performer attempting testing.merge MUST exit 1 with audit log entry. Verified by Test [E2E-PERFORMER-MERGE].
notes.master_emergency_block: master has all permissions EXCEPT emergency-responder-only actions (instance.terminate) — separation of duty for kill-switch authority.
notes.master_owns_miao: Per architecture diagram in src/permissions/roles/auditor.md, master sits at the top of the role hierarchy and can write/merge miao. Conductor cannot.
notes.auditor_inherits_readonly: auditor grants *.read + audit.export; blocks *.write / *.merge / instance.terminate (per src/permissions/roles/auditor.md + check.sh).
notes.closed_deny_set_audit: scripts/permission/authz/check.sh::is_read_only is a closed allowlist of read-only action suffixes used to gate the audit-write fail-closed path. State-changing actions that cannot be audited = fail-closed (exit 1).
notes.v2_super_admin_path: When v2 lands, update both check_permission (add super-admin case) AND role-matrix.json (replace super-admin cells with v2 grants).
